attributes.name: Personal Dashboard Catalog Listing
attributes.summary: The PersonalDashboard defines a customizable dashboard card designed to help users focus on daily and weekly priorities. It displays a focus area for today's task and a weekly goal, providing a clear overview of what matters. The card offers multiple visual layouts including a wide-format main view with detailed sections, an embedded compact view for quick snapshots, and a fitted version optimized for smaller spaces. Its primary purpose is to assist users in naming and tracking daily focus and weekly intentions within a personal or workspace context.
